title: Junior Selection Committee Meets to Discuss Future Talent
indian_angle: This meeting directly impacts the selection and development pathways for India's upcoming junior badminton players.
summary: The BAI Junior Selection Committee convened to review and plan for the development and selection of young talent in Indian badminton.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of this committee ensures Indian badminton players have a formal voice in the sport's governance and decision-making processes.
summary: Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at providing a platform for players to represent their interests and contribute to the sport's development.

title: India Prepares for World Junior Championships with Guwahati Camp
indian_angle: This national coaching camp at NCE Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, bringing together India's junior badminton hopefuls for intensive training ahead of the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Conducts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This advanced coaching course is vital for enhancing the quality of coaching across India, directly impacting the future performance of Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully organized a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at its National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, focusing on upgrading coaching skills.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will significantly alter gameplay and strategy for young Indian players in domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
